blocks.text: I wanted to open a thread where we can keep our updates on the {{fact:f:E-2022-001.client}} media program in one place, so nothing important lives only in a stray inbox. I have copied Kimberly Le and Melissa Zimmerman from our side; you will see their names as the work moves, and either of them can pick up a question if I am away from my desk.

We have made a start. Kimberly Le is reading through the recent coverage so we know what is already being said about the company, and Melissa Zimmerman has begun the financial summary that will sit behind the announcement. You will hear from us on a steady cadence from here, with each note tied to the piece of work it concerns.

Before we go much further, it would help to know who signs off on the announcement on your side, and roughly when you expect the window to open. For the record, I will treat approvals as yours to give, Sandra Mcdaniel, unless you would rather point me to someone else.
